description: This file implements shared channel membership synchronization logic in Mattermost, including handling individual and batch membership changes, syncing all members to remotes, and managing remote cluster communication.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Service class managing shared channel membership synchronization and remote cluster interactions.

methods.name: isChannelMemberSyncEnabled
methods.description: Checks if shared channel member synchronization is enabled based on feature flags and remote cluster service availability.

methods.name: queueMembershipSyncTask
methods.description: Creates and queues a task to synchronize channel membership changes.

methods.name: HandleMembershipChange
methods.description: Handles individual user addition or removal from a shared channel, creating a sync message and queuing it.

methods.name: HandleMembershipBatchChange
methods.description: Handles batch user membership changes for a shared channel, creating a sync message for multiple users.

methods.name: SyncAllChannelMembers
methods.description: Synchronizes all current members of a channel to a remote, handling incremental updates based on LastMembersSyncAt.

methods.name: syncMembersIndividually
methods.description: Queues individual membership change tasks for each member, optimized for small channels.

methods.name: syncMembersInBatches
methods.description: Processes members in batches for efficient synchronization of large channels.

methods.name: ForceMembershipSyncForRemote
methods.description: Re-syncs channel memberships for all channels shared with a remote cluster when it comes back online.

methods.name: processMembershipChange
methods.description: Processes a membership change sync message, determining which remotes to notify.

methods.name: syncMembershipBatchToRemotes
methods.description: Sends batch membership changes to all remote clusters except the initiator.
